::: notes

Give students time to fill the last column before revealing one row at a time. The four multipliers are: decibels, 10^(1/10)≈1.258925 (about ×1.259); seismic amplitude, 10; stellar brightness, 10^(-1/2.5)=10^-0.4≈0.398107 (about ×0.398); hydrogen-ion concentration, 10^-1=0.1. Negative coefficients mean a higher reading corresponds to a smaller physical quantity. The factors act on the underlying quantity, not on the scale reading itself. Use Previous row and Reset to revisit. The pH table retains the booklet's shorthand, where [H+] denotes the numerical concentration in mol/L. Allow about 5 minutes.

:::
